name: judge_continuity
description: Submit two PNG/JPEG keyframes for the fixed continuity rubric; poll get_task. Paid evaluation requires normal approval. Default dry-run is skipped, never a continuity verdict.

before_image_b64.description: Strict base64 PNG/JPEG keyframe, at most 4 MiB and 16 million pixels. No URL or local path.

after_image_b64.description: Strict base64 PNG/JPEG keyframe, at most 4 MiB and 16 million pixels. No URL or local path.

model.description: Optional Gemini model ID; empty uses GEMINI_VLM_MODEL. UNVERIFIED models are dry-run only.

name: get_task
description: Poll an existing Gemini interaction once. No new paid submission. Skipped reports remain incomplete checks and never block rendering.

job_id.description: Exact ASCII interaction ID returned by judge_continuity; reuse without resubmitting.

model.description: Optional Gemini model ID; empty uses GEMINI_VLM_MODEL. UNVERIFIED models are dry-run only.

name: judge_shots
description: Label numbered 15%/85% contact-sheet pairs. No model timing. Normal paid non-video approval and spend limits apply. Poll get_task with rubric=reference_shots and the same shot_ids. Dry-run produces no labels.

model.description: Optional Gemini model ID; empty uses GEMINI_VLM_MODEL. UNVERIFIED models are dry-run only.
